name: Conscript Helm
description: A battered iron helm worn by new recruits.

name: Conscript Collar
description: A crude neck guard offering minimal protection.

name: Conscript Chest
description: Padded leather chest armour. Stops the smallest of blows.

name: Iron Ring
description: A plain iron ring. Somehow sharpens the wearer's strikes.

name: Worn Band
description: A scratched metal band. No discernible power remains.

name: Draft Horse
description: A sturdy workhorse. Occasionally charges into the fray with surprising force.

name: Conscript Boots
description: Worn leather boots. Better than bare feet.

name: Conscript Gloves
description: Rough cloth gloves. Barely break-in.

name: Pano's War Helm
description: Legendary questing helm of the lost vanguard Pano. Hums with old power.

name: Pano's Amulet
description: An amulet warm to the touch, part of Pano's questing regalia.

name: Pano's Cuirass
description: The famed breastplate of Pano. Turns aside blows that would fell a lesser fighter.

name: Pano's Signet
description: A signet ring that sharpens the wearer's strikes.

name: Pano's Band
description: The companion band to Pano's signet. Steadies the hand in battle.

name: Pano's Steed
description: Pano's tireless warhorse. Charges with devastating force.

name: Pano's Greaves
description: Greaves that carry the wearer surefooted across any field.

name: Pano's Gauntlets
description: Gauntlets that lend crushing strength to every strike.

name: Oathsteel Helm
description: Forged from oathsteel and the shards of a hundred conscript helms.

name: Weir Kettle Helm
description: Frontier issue. The brim is wide because rain ruins a bowstring faster than an enemy does.

name: Weir Gorget
description: Plate at the throat and nowhere else. The Weir learned which wounds end a watch.

name: Weir Brigandine
description: Riveted from the scrap of three older coats. Every plate in it has already survived something.

name: Causeway Seal Ring
description: Ash-pitted signet of a road warden. The Ashen Causeway still has wardens. They are just not paid.

name: Marchwarden's Band
description: Worn thin at one edge, where a thumb rubbed through forty years of standing still.

name: Weir Courser
description: Bred for the courier roads. Not fast. Tireless, which on the frontier is the same as fast.

name: Weir Marchboots
description: Resoled more times than made. The Weir counts a boot's age in roads, not years.

name: Weir Handguards
description: Cut long at the wrist. A frontier warden reaches into places they cannot see.

name: Relaykeeper's Hood
description: Oiled against frost, hemmed in lamp-black. Worn by the ones who kept the dead lamps burning.

name: Torc of the Quiet Wind
description: Cold iron, warm at the throat. The Watch says it hums a half-beat before a relay fails.

name: Relay Coat
description: Long, grey, unremarkable, which is the point. A courier who is looked at twice is a dead courier.

name: Lamplighter's Seal
description: Proof the bearer may enter a sealed relay. Nine in ten of those relays no longer answer.

name: Vaultkeeper's Band
description: Taken from the Sunken Vaults, which the Watch marked as sealed and the water did not.

name: Relay Charger
description: Trained to run a route with no rider. Several still do, on roads no one has walked in an Age.

name: Frostmere Treads
description: Nailed for ice. Frostmere takes a careless step and keeps it.

name: Lampwright's Grips
description: Scorched across the palms. The lamps of the Watch were never meant to be handled cold.

name: Sable Vein Circlet
description: Archive work. The script around the band is a catalogue number, and the thing catalogued is you.

name: Threnody Collar
description: Worn by a scribe who recorded a Manifestation from close enough to be corrected by it.

name: Mantle of the Sable Vein
description: Black on black, and the inner black is older. The Houses do not explain their dyes.

name: House Sable Seal
description: Opens an archive hall that appears on no map the Houses admit to holding.

name: Vein-Cut Band
description: Split by a hairline fracture that has not widened in two hundred years of being watched.

name: Sable Courser
description: Archive stock. It will not cross running water, and the Houses have never said why.

name: Stair-Worn Boots
description: Taken off the Eternal Stair. The wear is at the toe, not the heel. Whoever wore them was climbing.

name: Archivist's Grips
description: Thin, precise, reinforced at the fingertips. Some things in an archive must be held down.

name: The Cinder-Cuff
description: Wrath-slag, cooled and cuffed. It makes the wearer stronger and angrier in the same motion, and does not distinguish between the two.

name: The Unworn Crown
description: A circlet of a dark metal no living smith can name, made for a head no carving depicts. It has never, in any account, been worn. The Old Guard kept it because they were afraid to be the ones who found out why.

name: The Vanguard's Cold Token
description: Kin to the lost signet: the same unknown script worn nearly smooth, the same cold that does not warm in the hand. Nobody alive can read it. That is the whole of what is known.

name: Colossus-Core Shard
description: Pried from a war-construct that never stood down. It still pulses with the last order it was given, and there is no one left to amend it: hold.

name: Sovereign's Tithe-Mark
description: Granted by the Gauntlet in the name of the founding pact. It marks a fighter as having paid the tithe. What the Sovereign was promised is recorded nowhere a fighter may read.

name: The Sealwright's Stylus
description: The instrument that inscribed null-sigil bindings, the script that holds a thing closed. The Old Guard made few and accounted for every one. This one is not on the ledger.
